title: VRF record (SPEC section 15, row 'VRF')
description: Every VRF parameter is constructor-fixed (SPEC section 7.1): coordinator, subscription id and its multisig owner, key hash, native billing, requestConfirmations=200, numWords=2, callbackGasLimit=300,000, the maxRequestCostNative derivation, the consumer registration receipt and the key-hash getter confirmed against the coordinator ABI.

costDerivation.description: maxRequestCostNative = maxGasPrice x (callbackGasLimit + verificationGasOverhead) x (1 + premium%) + flat native premium (SPEC section 7.1). Recorded so the number can be rechecked, not trusted.

coordinator.description: Immutable coordinator address held by ImmutableVRFConsumer. There is no migration setter.

coordinatorIsMock.description: True only for a labeled local mock coordinator. Must be false outside the local environment.

subscriptionOwner.description: The multisig that owns the subscription. A deployed fact, so it is absent from a plan.

keyHash.description: Supported key hash, lowest gas lane. requestDraw pre-checks that the coordinator still reports it as registered (SPEC sections 6.2 and 7.1).

nativeBilling.description: SPEC section 7.1: native BNB billing from the operator subscription.

consumerRegistered.description: The Draw address is a registered consumer of the subscription. A deployed fact, so it is absent from a plan.

keyHashGetter.description: The getter the deploy script asserts on the coordinator so the section 6.2 pre-check can never become a permanent revert (SPEC section 15).

lowFundingThresholdNative.description: Subscription low-balance alert threshold (SPEC sections 10.2 and 15).

measuredCallbackGasUsed.description: Measured consumer gas for the worst valid callback; section 11.2 requires <= 150,000 against the 300,000 budget. Null until measured.

subscriptionOwner.$comment: Constrained in $defs/vrfCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.

consumerRegistered.$comment: Constrained in $defs/vrfCommon; named here only so "required" refers to a defined property.
